THE CONQUEST CAN BE MORALLY DEFENDED · PAUL COPAN
"there are some things that God cannot command"

In his closing, Copan distinguishes intrinsically forbidden acts from rare judgments whose wider circumstances might override an otherwise sound moral presumption.

"

THE MORAL DEFENSE IS INADEQUATE · RANDAL RAUSER
"slaughtering children and women and the elderly and the infirm is also intrinsically wrong"

In his final statement, Rauser compares civilian slaughter with other acts he regards as exceptionlessly wrong and rejects a temporary divine exemption.
